svg.title: FAS2GeometricDistributionSVG-003: Wording to symbols exam card
svg.desc: Exam card translating wording into symbols and formulae.
svg.text: First write the probability statement. Then choose the formula.

g.text: exactly x: P(X = x) p(1 − p)^(x − 1)
at most x: P(X ≤ x) 1 − (1 − p)^x
fewer than x: P(X < x)=P(X ≤ x − 1) 1 − (1 − p)^(x − 1)
more than x: P(X > x) (1 − p)^x
at least x: P(X ≥ x) (1 − p)^(x − 1)
